items.definition: A comfortable chair with sides for your arms.
items.example: I sit in the armchair and read.

items.definition: A container filled with water to wash your body.
items.example: She takes a bath every evening.

items.definition: A piece of furniture you sleep on.
items.example: I go to bed at ten.

items.definition: A thick cloth covering that covers the floor.
items.example: The carpet in my room is red.

items.definition: A machine you use to cook food.
items.example: The cooker is in the kitchen.

items.definition: A piece of furniture with doors for storing things.
items.example: We keep plates in the cupboard.

items.definition: A machine that cleans plates and cups.
A place in a wall for a fire.
items.example: There is a fireplace in the living room.

items.definition: A machine that keeps food cold.
items.example: The milk is in the fridge.

items.definition: A thing that makes a room bright.
A machine that heats food quickly.
items.example: I heat the food in the microwave.

items.definition: A thing that shows your face.
A green living thing that grows in soil.
items.example: I water my plant every day.

items.definition: A flat board on a wall for putting things.
items.example: The books are on the shelf.

items.definition: A place where you wash your body with water.
items.example: I take a shower in the morning.

items.definition: A long soft seat for two or more people.
items.example: We sit on the sofa together.

items.definition: A large cupboard where you keep your clothes.
items.example: My clothes are in the wardrobe.

items.definition: A machine that cleans clothes with water.
items.example: I put my clothes in the washing machine.
